RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 2, 2006/Sravana 11, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —20
† Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Freedom fighters
†*141. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise number of freedom
fighters, as on date;
(b) whether Government are aware of
miserable condition of the families of
freedom fighters;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have
formulated any scheme to provide relief to
the families of the freedom fighters; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Slow industrial growth
*142. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the slow
down in manufacturing, power and mining
sectors has pulled down industrial growth;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken to boost these
sectors, for better industrial growth?
FDI in manufacturing
industries
†*143. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government consider
Foreign Direct Investment as essential for
the growth of manufacturing industries in
the country;
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
how much FDI is being assessed to be
needed for this sector in the present
circumstances;
(c) whether Government are formulating
a new scheme to promote foreign direct
investment in the manufacturing industries;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

45
Threat to livelihood by FTAs
*144. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Free Trade Agreements
entered into with different nations are
threatening the livelihood of majority of
population in our country;
(b) whether it is a fact that the agreements
entered with Nepal and Sri Lanka are
particularly inimical to the interests of agro-
based industries such as vanaspati; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to protect the interests of the
Indian agro-based industries?
Ban on SIMI
*145. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA:
SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a ban has been imposed on
the Students Islamic Movement of India
(SIMI) as unlawful organization;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the year-wise details of the number of its
activists taken into custody, prosecuted,
convicted and/or acquitted since imposition
of the ban;
(c) whether, despite the ban the activists
of SIMI have been allowed to carry on its
activities in various States;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the details as to the nature of alert, if
any, decimated from intelligence agencies
about involvement of SIMI activists in
perpetration of unlawful acts; and
(f) the action taken in the light thereof?
Unemployment allowance to
Engineering Graduates
*146. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether National Technical
Manpower Information System has made
any survey in the recent past to know the
unemployment rate of engineering graduates
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken to provide them
employment; and
(d) whether there is any proposal to
provide them with unemployment
allowance?
PMGSY in Gujarat
*147. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: W ill the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that funds for the
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
(PMGSY) are given to the States from the
collection of cess levied on diesel;
(b) the amount of such collection from
Gujarat during the last three years; year-wise;
(c) the amount of disbursement to that
State from this fund during the same period,
year-wise; and
(d) whether it is a fact that this
disbursement is not based of tax collection
from diesel consumed in Gujarat?
Employment opportunities
*148. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

46
had targeted creation of around five crore
employment opportunities during the Tenth
Five Year Plan period;
(b) if so, the steps taken to achieve the
target; and
(c) the target achieved so far, sector-
wise and State-wise?
Formation of Geographical
Identification Registry
*149. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
formation of a Geographical Identification
Registry for the country for region-specific
agro-produce like Darjeeling Tea, Nagpur
Oranges and Coorg Coffee;
(b) if so, the tentative list of products
to be listed in the Registry;
(c) whether rose onion which is
exclusively grown in Central Karnataka,
Government would consider listing of other
commodities like Bangalore Agarbaties and
Sandal products, which are also region
specific; and
(d) whether products like Sivakasi
match boxes, Morbi clocks and Aligarh
locks qualify for inclusion in the Registry?
Duty free import of foodgrain items
*150. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
allowed private traders to import duty free
foodgrain items and if so, the details thereof,
including the names of the traders and the
country from which these items are being
imported; and
(b) whether Government have formulated
any guidelines for the sale of these items in
the market by them and if so, the details
thereof and if not, the reasons therefor?
Legislation for occupational safety
and health
*151. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is as
yet no comprehensive national legislation
pertaining to occupational safety and health;
and
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to bring any Bill before the Parliament in
this regard?
Policy to deal with terrorism
*152. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have framed
any policy to deal with terrorism in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Juveniles detained in jails with
hardened criminals
*153. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Juveniles are
detained alongwith adult and hardened
criminals in Tihar jail in Delhi, and in other
jails in the country, despite the law
prohibiting such detentions; and

47
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to bring any amendment to the law; if not,
what steps are being taken to protect the
children from ill effects of such company,
and they being subjected to abuse?
Setting up of Manufacturing
Investment Regions
*154. SHRI MAHENDRA
MOHAN:
SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND  INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
has been formulated to set up five
Manufacturing Investment Regions
(MIRs), on the lines of the Special
Economic Zones (SEZs);
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
present status of its implementation;
(c) the details of regions/specific
locations identified State-wise, for setting
up the proposed Manufacturing Regions
and the criteria evolved for such selection;
and
(d) the details of fresh guidelines drawn
up, if any, for speedy acquisition of land
for the MIRs and for suitable
rehabilitation package for the oustees to
avoid any long-drawn litigations, cost and
time overruns, in implementing the
projects?
Agricultural produces included in FTA
*155. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of agricultural produces
included under Free Trade Agreement with
ASEAN countries;
(b) whether it is fact that India agreed
to cut down the items to 852 from the initial
sensitive list of 1414 items;
(c) if so, the details of items excluded
from the initial sensitive list;
(d) whether the items are mostly
produced in India, especially in Kerala;
(e) if so, whether import of these items
would adversely affect the indigenous
farmers; and
(f) whether any safeguards have been in
place to protect the interests of the farmers
in the country?
Ban on export of iron-ore
†*156. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND  INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that steel
producers in the country have demanded a
ban on export of iron-ore;
(b) if so, whether Government have
turned down this demand for the time
being; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and
whether it is also a fact that higher amounts
can be earned in the country by exports,
by enhancing the cost of iron-ore?
NREGA in North Eastern States
*157. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the extent of employment generated
upto 15th July, 2006, by application of
the National Rural Employment Guarantee
Act NREGA in different districts, State-
wise;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

48
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 27th July, 2006 Secretary-General.
Sravana 5, 1928 ( Saka)
(b) the number of districts where
NREGA has been in force;
(c) the number of new districts to be
included in the programme during the
current financial year; and
(d) whether all the districts of the
North-Eastern States would be considered
for inclusion in the NREGA programme
considering the serious backwardness of
this region?
Hide-outs of terrorists in
Maharashtra
†*158. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some hide-
outs of terrorists were unearthed in the
Marathwada region of Maharashtra,
recently;
(b) if so, the number of persons arrested
so far in this regard;
(c) the effective steps taken by
Government to prevent terrorists from
setting up their hide-outs in Marathwada
area in future; and
(d) whether Government have made any
contact with local residents for seeking their
co-operation with regard to terrorists?
Funds under Rural Development
Schemes
*159. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the total amount of funds
sanctioned by Government under different
Rural Development schemes during the last
three years;
(b) what is the total amount of matching
grant that Karnataka has to provide and
whether the State has released the amount
for the schemes; and
(c) whether the amount was full utilized;
if not, what are the reasons therefor?
Percentage of women in Indian Army
†*160. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of women in Indian
Army;
(b) the specific steps being taken by
Government to increase number of women
in the Army; and
(c) the percentage of women targeted
by Government in the army with
percentage of officers and soldiers therein?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the August 2, 2006/Sravana 11, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
Representation to Bihar in Tea Board
†864. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that extensive
farming of tea has been undertaken in
Kishanganj district of Bihar during the past
several years;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Bihar
has not been given representation in the
Tea Board by nominating any tea
entrepreneur from that State as a member;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Effect of import of edible oils
†865. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are importing
edible oils from other countries;
(b) if so, the quantity thereof and the
names of those countries, togetherwith the
rates at which oil is being imported;
(c) whether it would adversely affect
the edible oil business of the country; and
(d) its impact on the producers of
mustard and soyabean?
Production capacity of cement
industry
866. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the present production capacity of
cement industry in the country;
(b) whether the production of cement
in the country has fallen short of demand
during the last three years;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
enhance the production capacity of the
cement industry?
Import of coconut oil
867. SHRI A.K. ANTONY: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of coconut oil imported
in the year 2005-06;
(b) whether Government have received
any representation to stop such imports,
in order to save the coconut growers from
the crashing prices;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

200
(c) whether Government are considering
quantity restrictions on the import of
coconut oil; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
National network of producers of
agriculture related sectors
868. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
create a national network of producers, co-
operative bodies in agriculture, horticulture
and other related primary sectors, to market
and export products; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the steps taken and the organizations
associated with the above, as on date?
Comprehensive Economic
Cooperation Agreements
869. SHRI RA VULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have signed
any Comprehensive Economic Cooperation
Agreement with any country;
(b) if so, the details thereof country-
wise; and
(c) the trade reported so far with each
country?
Countries posing threat to Indian
exports
870. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Sri Lanka,
Kenya, Vietnam, Indonesia and Guatemala
have emerged as major threats to Indian
exports;
(b) if so, the total quantum of exports
of Indian tea, pepper and cardamom during
the last three years, vis-a-vis above
countries; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
boost plantation sector in India?
Decline in export of diamonds and
jewellery
†871. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: W ill the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the export of diamond and
jewellery has been declining for the last
two years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons ascertained by
Government for such decline; and
(d) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Duty exemption schemes for exports
872. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the outlines of the existing schemes
involving tax and duty exemptions for
encouraging exports; and
(b) the total amount involved per year
in extending various concessions under the
above schemes?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

201
Setting up of SEZs in Tamil Nadu
873. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Board of Approval is
considering setting up of Special Economic
Zones (SEZs) at various locations in the
country;
(b) if so, the locations under
consideration in Tamil Nadu; and
(c) the incentive and facilities likely to
be given to the proposed SEZs?
Ban on export of iron-ore
874. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether steel producers and the
Associated Chambers of Commerce and
Industry of India (ASSOCHAM) have
demanded total ban on export of iron-ore;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) the total export of iron-ore during
the last three years, year-wise;
(d) whether it is a fact that other
countries where iron-ore deposits are
available, export only the finished products;
and
(e) if so, the steps taken by Government
on the above requests?
Re-opening of closed tea gardens in
Darjeeling
875. SHRI SAMAN PATHAK: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to re-
open the closed tea gardens in Darjeeling;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Ill effects of weather on coffee growers
876. SHRIMATI PREMA CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that adverse
weather conditions had severely affected
the productivity of the coffee estates in
the past;
(b) if so, the action taken by
Government to provide relief to the coffee
growers, whose productivity was affected
by the adverse weather conditions; and
(c) whether Government have a long
term policy to protect the coffee growers
from the ill effects of the adverse weather
conditions?
SEZs in Andhra Pradesh
877. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Special Economic
Zones in Andhra Pradesh, sector-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that an IT-
product-specific Special Economic Zone
was inaugurated recently at Keesarpalli
village in Krishna District of that State;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the State
Government is very keen to develop
Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Tirupati,
Warrangal, Guntur and Nellore as Tier-II
cities, besides Hyderabad, for the
promotion of IT industry; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

202
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Steps to increase exports
†878. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the present
quantum of imports is higher than the
exports;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
import rate has registered about 31 per cent
increase, in comparison to the last years;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof for the last
three years, and the effective steps taken
by Government to increase exports, in
comparison to imports?
Increase in sick industries
879. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is an increase in the
number of industries declared as sick
industries during the last three years;
(b) whether any assessment has been
made about these industries, which are
mainly becoming sick; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
arrest such trends?
Role of DGFT in export-import
880. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the role of the Directorate
General of Foreign Trade in the export-
import scenario of the country is limited in
the WTO regime;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the main functions of the DGFT
prior to the liberalisation of export-import
trade and thereafter; and
(d) the role of the DGFT in the coming
years in the expanding liberalised export-
import trade of the country?
Funds to Andhra Pradesh under
Growth Centre Scheme
881. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds released to
Andhra Pradesh under the Growth Centre
Scheme and the Central Grant under the
Industrial Infrastructure Upgradation
Scheme during the last three years;
(b) whether Government have
appointed any consultancy agency to take
up evaluation for industrialisation in Andhra
Pradesh; and
(c) if so, the details thereof, alongwith
the results thereof?
Modification of FDI norms in
agriculture and plantation
882. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have modified
certain norms of FDI policy, according to
the recommendations of the Group of
Ministers, headed by the Minister of
Agriculture, allowing 100 per cent FDI in
agriculture and plantation sector;
(b) if so, the details of the changes made;
(c) whether the left parties have
opposed the decision to allow 100 per cent
FDI in agriculture and plantation sector, as

203
it will ruin millions of farmers and planters
who are already facing hardships; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Crop diversification in tea gardens
883. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
crop diversification in tea gardens of North
Bengal in view of the deteriorating
conditions of tea industry; and
(b) if so, the details in this regard?
Multinationals in retail market
†884. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that multinational
companies, alongwith big industrialists in
the country have started to enter in the
retail market in the smaller cities alongwith
big cities;
(b) if so, the details of multinational
companies and companies of big
industrialists which have taken decision in
this regard so far; and
(c) the total capital proposed to be
invested by those companies in the retail
market?
Export oriented industrial units
†885. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: W ill the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of business carried
out by export-oriented industrial units out
of the total import-export trade of the
country, during the last two years;
(b) the total amount of foreign exchange
earned by the said units during the same
period; and
(c) whether it is a fact that being export-
oriented units, these units are also getting
various economic concessions and if so,
the total amount of concession given to
them in the said years?
Fall in prices of spices
886. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there have
been a fall in the prices of spices;
(b) if so, the details of the prices of
spices during the last three years, year-
wise and produce-wise;
(c) whether Government have since
ascertained the reasons for the continuous
fall in the prices of spices;
(d) whether Government would take
steps to procure the produces with a
minimum support price; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

204
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Trained infiltrators being sent by
Pakistan
†887. MS SUSHILA TIRIYA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Pakistan is sending trained infiltrators in
the hills of Poonch;
(b) the number of attempts made by
infiltrators at Poonch border through LOC
during last two months;
(c) whether Government have held any
talks with Government of Pakistan in this
regard; if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether, according to the Defence
Exports, situation in Poonch is taking a
turn similar to the Kargil war; and
(e) if so, whether Government are
prepared to handle emergent
circumstances?
Super-sensitive contract to black-
listed firm
888. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the recent media reports
entitled "Black-listed firm got DRDO's
'super-sensitive' contract";
(b) if so, how such a serious lapse went
unnoticed in the Ministry;
(c) whether the Ministry propose to
institute an investigation as to how this
happened; and
(d) whether deterrent action would be
taken against the official responsible for
such a serious lapse?
Purchase of three warships from
Russia
889. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have finally
decided to purchase three warships from
Russia, recently;
(b) if so, the price of each such warship
and when they are expected to reach India;
(c) whether each of these ships would
be fully equipped on the pattern of earlier
warship, INS Prahar, which was purchased
at the cost of Rs. 200 crore and sank in an
accident with merchant vessel, Rajiv
Gandhi; and
(d) if so, how arms and ammunitions
purchased from Russia are reliable and
dependable like MiG 21/MiG 25 and MiG
29?
Ban on mobile phones in offices
†890. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have banned
carrying of mobile-cum-camera phones in
offices including I.B. considered sensitive
from security view point; and
(b) if so, the number of offices identified
for this purpose?
Purchase of warships from Russia
891. SHRI VEDPRAKASH P.
GOYAL: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to purchase three more 4000
tonnes warships from Russia;

205
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details regarding the
configuration and advantages of these
warships; and
(c) the details regarding the technical
advantages of these warships, which would
improve our Naval power and how much
this deal will cost?
Increase in cross-border infiltration
in J&K
†892. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the incidents
of cross-border infiltration in Jammu and
Kashmir have increased since sometime ago;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of infiltrators captured
and killed by the para military forces in the
incidents which took place during the last
six months; and
(d) the details of injured and killed
personnel of the army and para military
forces in said incidents?
Shortage of helicopters in military
